One of the most excruciating headaches amongst different types of a headache is the migraine headache. This is especially known for the throbbing effect on the head that is unilateral in nature and occurs at a random phase.

This problem associated with the nervous system is a difficult one to define since the intensity happens to be different from various people. Hence, to take minimum care of this disorder, it is best that one should be aware of what exactly the disorder is about.

What is migraine:

Speaking in medical terms, it is a severe and excruciating headache that is normally preceded or succeeded by flashes of light and uneasiness within the body. The pain is of the throbbing type, with unilateral tendencies.

This headache can initially range from a couple of hours to a maximum three days, and is primarily caused by a drop in serotonin levels. This serotonin is a chemical that helps in reducing the pain in the head, while with its lack of presence, the neuropeptide is released that causes the pain in the head, resulting in a migraine headache.

Various signs of a migraine headache:

It is always better to be on the safe side, rather than be sorry. This is primarily the reason one should be very careful regarding the headache that they would face. Once, a person recognises the type of headache that could happen or the various signs that might be close to the symptoms; it will be easier to understand what is migraine and what measures should be taken?

  • Unilateral throbbing pain that could last for quite some time.
  • Intense sensitivity towards light and sound.
  • The nauseousfeeling results in vomiting and dizziness.
  • Sudden triggering of certain allergic reactions, or eve hormonal triggers.

All these signs need to be taken with a little more concern and hence, people should actually be more careful in case of such signs. They can act as precedence to the actual headache.

Migraines and the various facets associated with it:

With migraine there is a very important factor associated which is an aura. These can be said to be certain alarms, and are neurological disorders causing a direct effect on visual power. There are various types such as seeing coloured spots, zigzag lights, tunnel type vision and even temporary blindness.

Causes associated with migraine:

To understand exactly what is migraine, it is very important to know various causes that are associated with it.

  • Certain food items such as processed meat, aged cheese, chocolate, spicy food items and such other types of specialised foods are the possible threats for immediate triggers of migraine pain.
  • Intense noise, or prolonged exposure to strong lights.
  • Skipping meals and prolonged periods of hunger can also result in migraine pain.

Getting the proper cure: In case a migraine pain is hinted at, it is best that a person consults a doctor. Only a medical practitioner can help in understanding what is migraine, and provide the required relief in this regard.
